messages.subject: Calderdale House, Manchester — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

Lovely to speak earlier. As discussed, please find attached our engagement letter for the acquisition of the freehold of Calderdale House, 14–18 Sefton Street, Manchester. It sets out scope, our team and a fee estimate of £18,000–£22,000 plus VAT and disbursements.

Elena Marchetti will run the file day to day. Once you have signed and returned the letter we will request title and the data room from Pemberton Rowe and start our review. To meet your end-of-quarter completion target we will be aiming to exchange by early March.

Kind regards,
Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
